name: Chloe (church member)
title: Member of the Corinthian church and informant
summary: Chloe was a woman in the early Christian church whose household informed the apostle Paul about divisions in the church at Corinth. She is mentioned only once in the Bible, but her role as an information source was important for Paul's pastoral care of the Corinthian church.

keyEvents.title: Chloe's people report divisions
keyEvents.description: Members of Chloe's household informed Paul that there were quarrels and divisions in the church at Corinth, where people were gathering around different leaders such as Paul, Apollos, and Cephas.

keyEvents.title: Context for Paul's exhortations on unity
keyEvents.description: The information from Chloe's people gave Paul grounds to write about the importance of unity in Christ and warn against factionalism in the church.
